description: Scramble the interior letters of every word while keeping the first and last letters in place.

faqs.a: Yes — research shows text stays readable when only interior letters are jumbled.
Words of 3 letters or fewer and punctuation are left untouched.

faqs.q: Is the scrambling different each time?
faqs.a: Yes — press Scramble again for a fresh jumbling of the same text.

howto: Copy the result or scramble again.
title: Word Scrambler
